text: わたしも　いつか　かっこいい　トレーナーに　なれるのかな？

structure.jp: かっこいい　トレーナーに

structure.en: I wonder if I can become?

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing なる to なれる turns 'become' into 'can become'. なれる = 'can become'

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', said half to yourself; の makes it a wondering about how things really are. なれるのかな = 'I wonder if I can become one'
